title: Scope the shipped inventory's registered Git-input paragraph to passing evaluations and stored commit decisions
outcome: Scope the shipped inventory's registered Git-input paragraph to passing evaluations and stored commit decisions
acceptance: docs/shipped.md's registered Git-input paragraph says that Engram reads the named root and requires a declared complete source_id and a matching passed registered check only for a new evaluation containing a pass (non-pass verdicts stay recordable without one), that the source_id-check-first need applies to such evaluations, and that unevaluated completion can still use a current stored commit check under the historical clean-at-commit rule, matching src/storage/work/acceptance_evaluation.rs and completion/acceptance_bindings.rs
The changeset passes the focused link check and a Codex + Claude review pair
